column1: purple|n.|紫色|The sky turned purple at dusk.|黃昏時天空變成了紫色。|She wore a purple dress to the party.|她穿著紫色洋裝去參加派對。
pink|n.|粉紅色|She painted her room pink.|她把房間漆成粉紅色。|Pink flowers covered the tree.|粉紅色的花朵開滿了整棵樹。
beige|n.|米色|The sofa is beige and goes with any color.|這張沙發是米色的，和任何顏色都搭。|He wore a beige coat in autumn.|他在秋天穿著一件米色外套。
navy|n.|海軍藍，深藍色|He bought a navy suit for work.|他買了一套深藍色西裝上班穿。|The school uniform is navy and white.|學校制服是深藍色和白色。
violet|n.|紫羅蘭色|The flowers in the garden are violet.|花園裡的花是紫羅蘭色的。|She picked a violet ribbon for her hair.|她挑了一條紫羅蘭色的緞帶綁頭髮。
turquoise|n.|青綠色，土耳其藍|The sea was a beautiful turquoise.|海水呈現美麗的青綠色。|She wore a turquoise necklace.|她戴著一條土耳其藍的項鍊。
maroon|n.|栗色，暗紅色|He painted the door maroon.|他把門漆成了暗紅色。|Her maroon sweater looks warm.|她的栗色毛衣看起來很溫暖。
cyan|n.|青色，藍綠色|The printer uses cyan, magenta and yellow ink.|這台印表機使用青色、洋紅色和黃色墨水。|The water in the pool looked bright cyan.|泳池的水看起來是亮藍綠色。
lavender|n.|薰衣草色；薰衣草|The walls of the bedroom are pale lavender.|臥室的牆壁是淡淡的薰衣草色。|Lavender has a calming smell.|薰衣草有安撫人心的香氣。
crimson|n.|深紅色|The leaves turned crimson in autumn.|葉子在秋天變成深紅色。|She wore a crimson scarf.|她戴著一條深紅色的圍巾。
blackboard|n.|黑板|The teacher wrote the date on the blackboard.|老師把日期寫在黑板上。|Please erase the blackboard before class.|上課前請把黑板擦乾淨。
dormitory|n.|宿舍|Most freshmen live in the dormitory.|大多數新生都住在宿舍。|The dormitory has a curfew at eleven.|宿舍晚上十一點有門禁。
sad|adj.|悲傷的，難過的|I felt sad when my friend moved away.|朋友搬走時我覺得很難過。|The movie has a sad ending.|這部電影有個悲傷的結局。
excited|adj.|興奮的，興致勃勃的|The kids are excited about the trip.|孩子們對這趟旅行感到很興奮。|I'm so excited to see you again!|能再見到你我好興奮！
scared|adj.|害怕的|The little boy was scared of the dark.|小男孩怕黑。|I was scared when I heard a loud noise.|我聽到一聲巨響時嚇壞了。
worried|adj.|擔心的|She is worried about her exam results.|她擔心考試成績。|Don't be worried; everything will be fine.|別擔心，一切都會沒事的。
jealous|adj.|嫉妒的，吃醋的|He was jealous of his brother's success.|他嫉妒哥哥的成功。|She felt jealous when her friend got a new phone.|朋友換了新手機，她覺得很羨慕嫉妒。
embarrassed|adj.|尷尬的，難為情的|I was embarrassed when I forgot his name.|我忘記他的名字時覺得很尷尬。|She looked embarrassed and her face turned red.|她看起來很難為情，臉都紅了。
lonely|adj.|孤單的，寂寞的|He felt lonely in the big city.|他在大城市裡覺得很孤單。|Many old people live alone and feel lonely.|許多老人獨居並感到寂寞。
surprised|adj.|驚訝的|I was surprised to see her at the party.|我在派對上看到她很驚訝。|She looked surprised when she opened the gift.|她打開禮物時看起來很驚訝。
confused|adj.|困惑的，混亂的|I'm confused by the instructions.|我被這些說明弄糊塗了。|The little girl looked confused and asked for help.|小女孩一臉困惑地求助。
disappointed|adj.|失望的|He was disappointed with his test score.|他對自己的考試成績感到失望。|We were disappointed when the concert was canceled.|演唱會被取消時，我們很失望。
relieved|adj.|鬆了一口氣的|I felt relieved when the exam was over.|考試結束時我鬆了一口氣。|She was relieved to hear that he was safe.|聽到他平安無事，她鬆了一口氣。
depressed|adj.|沮喪的，憂鬱的|He felt depressed after losing his job.|他失業後覺得很沮喪。|Rainy weather can make some people feel depressed.|雨天會讓有些人覺得情緒低落。
furious|adj.|狂怒的|She was furious when she saw the broken window.|她看到破掉的窗戶時氣炸了。|My father was furious about the noise.|我爸爸對噪音感到非常生氣。
terrified|adj.|嚇壞的，極度恐懼的|The child was terrified of the dog.|那個小孩被狗嚇壞了。|I was terrified when the plane shook.|飛機搖晃時我嚇壞了。
stressed|adj.|壓力大的|I feel stressed before every exam.|我每次考試前都覺得壓力很大。|Take a deep breath if you are stressed.|如果覺得壓力大，就深呼吸一下。
tired|adj.|疲倦的，累的|I'm too tired to cook tonight.|我今晚累得不想煮飯。|The kids were tired after the long walk.|走了很長的路後，孩子們都累了。
attic|n.|閣樓|We keep old boxes in the attic.|我們把舊箱子放在閣樓。|The attic is hot in summer.|閣樓在夏天很悶熱。
doorbell|n.|門鈴|The doorbell rang and I went to open the door.|門鈴響了，我去開門。|Press the doorbell and wait.|按門鈴然後等一下。
chimney|n.|煙囪|Smoke is coming out of the chimney.|煙囪正冒著煙。|Santa Claus comes down the chimney.|聖誕老人從煙囪爬下來。
toilet|n.|馬桶，廁所|The toilet is clogged again.|馬桶又堵住了。|Please flush the toilet after use.|使用後請沖馬桶。
living-room|n.|客廳|The whole family watches TV in the living room.|全家人都在客廳看電視。|We put a big sofa in the living room.|我們在客廳放了一張大沙發。
rice|n.|米飯，稻米|I'd like a bowl of rice with my meal.|我的餐點想配一碗白飯。|Rice is the main food in many Asian countries.|米飯是許多亞洲國家的主食。
noodle|n.|麵條|Beef noodle soup is my favorite dish.|牛肉麵是我最愛的菜。|She cooked noodles for lunch.|她午餐煮了麵。
pizza|n.|披薩|Let's order a pizza for dinner.|我們晚餐叫一份披薩吧。|He likes pizza with extra cheese.|他喜歡加量起司的披薩。
hamburger|n.|漢堡|I'd like a hamburger and a small coke.|我要一個漢堡和一杯小可樂。|The hamburger comes with fries.|這個漢堡附薯條。
sausage|n.|香腸|We grilled sausages at the barbecue.|我們在烤肉時烤了香腸。|Taiwanese sausage is sweet and tasty.|台灣香腸又甜又好吃。
bacon|n.|培根|He had bacon and eggs for breakfast.|他早餐吃了培根和蛋。|The bacon smells great.|培根聞起來好香。
egg|n.|蛋|I fried two eggs for breakfast.|我早餐煎了兩顆蛋。|How would you like your eggs?|您的蛋想要怎麼煮？
cheese|n.|起司|Do you want cheese on your sandwich?|你的三明治要加起司嗎？|Cheese is made from milk.|起司是用牛奶做成的。
butter|n.|奶油|Spread some butter on the bread.|在麵包上抹些奶油。|She melted the butter in a pan.|她在鍋裡融化奶油。
milk|n.|牛奶|I drink a glass of milk every morning.|我每天早上喝一杯牛奶。|Could you buy some milk on your way home?|你回家路上可以買些牛奶嗎？
yogurt|n.|優格|She eats yogurt with fruit for breakfast.|她早餐吃優格配水果。|Plain yogurt is good for your stomach.|原味優格對腸胃很好。
cereal|n.|麥片，穀片|I have a bowl of cereal with milk every morning.|我每天早上吃一碗牛奶麥片。|This cereal is low in sugar.|這款麥片糖分很低。
pasta|n.|義大利麵|We had pasta with tomato sauce for dinner.|我們晚餐吃了番茄醬義大利麵。|She cooks pasta very well.|她很會煮義大利麵。
cake|n.|蛋糕|We baked a cake for her birthday.|我們為她的生日烤了蛋糕。|Would you like a piece of cake?|你想要吃一塊蛋糕嗎？
chocolate|n.|巧克力|Dark chocolate is a little bitter.|黑巧克力有點苦。|He gave her a box of chocolate on Valentine's Day.|他在情人節送了她一盒巧克力。
candy|n.|糖果|The children got a lot of candy on Halloween.|孩子們在萬聖節拿到很多糖果。|Don't eat too much candy; it's bad for your teeth.|不要吃太多糖果，對牙齒不好。
ice-cream|n.|冰淇淋|The kids want ice cream after dinner.|孩子們晚餐後想吃冰淇淋。|I'll have a scoop of chocolate ice cream.|我要一球巧克力冰淇淋。
soda|n.|汽水|He ordered a cold soda with his burger.|他點了一杯冰汽水配漢堡。|Too much soda is bad for your health.|喝太多汽水對健康不好。
beer|n.|啤酒|They drank cold beer at the barbecue.|他們在烤肉時喝了冰啤酒。|He ordered a beer and some fries.|他點了一杯啤酒和一些薯條。
salt|n.|鹽|Please pass me the salt.|請把鹽遞給我。|Add a little salt to the soup.|在湯裡加一點鹽。
pork|n.|豬肉|She fried the pork with garlic.|她用大蒜炒豬肉。|Some people don't eat pork for religious reasons.|有些人因為宗教原因不吃豬肉。
jungle|n.|叢林|Many wild animals live in the jungle.|許多野生動物生活在叢林裡。|They walked through the thick jungle for hours.|他們在茂密的叢林中走了好幾個小時。
waterfall|n.|瀑布|We hiked to a beautiful waterfall.|我們健行到一座美麗的瀑布。|The sound of the waterfall was very loud.|瀑布的聲音非常大。
cliff|n.|懸崖|Don't stand too close to the edge of the cliff.|不要站得離懸崖邊緣太近。|The house was built on a cliff over the sea.|這間房子建在海上的懸崖上。
meadow|n.|草地，牧草地|Cows were grazing in the meadow.|牛群在草地上吃草。|We had a picnic in a flower-filled meadow.|我們在開滿花的草地上野餐。
pond|n.|池塘|Some ducks are swimming in the pond.|有幾隻鴨子正在池塘裡游泳。|There is a small pond behind our house.|我們家後面有一座小池塘。
peninsula|n.|半島|Korea is on a peninsula in East Asia.|韓國位於東亞的一座半島上。|The peninsula is surrounded by sea on three sides.|這座半島三面環海。
glacier|n.|冰河|The glacier is melting because of global warming.|因為全球暖化，冰河正在融化。|We took a boat to see the glacier.|我們搭船去看冰河。
canyon|n.|峽谷|The Grand Canyon is a famous tourist spot.|大峽谷是著名的旅遊景點。|The river runs through a deep canyon.|河流穿過一座深深的峽谷。
moon|n.|月亮|The moon is bright tonight.|今晚的月亮很亮。|People in Taiwan eat mooncakes during the Mid-Autumn Festival.|台灣人在中秋節吃月餅。
savings|n.|存款，儲蓄|She put all her savings into the bank.|她把所有存款都存進銀行。|He used his savings to buy a car.|他用存款買了一輛車。
charger|n.|充電器|I forgot my phone charger at home.|我把手機充電器忘在家裡了。|Can I borrow your charger?|我可以借用你的充電器嗎？
headphones|n.|耳機|He listens to music with headphones on the train.|他在火車上戴著耳機聽音樂。|These headphones are very comfortable.|這副耳機戴起來非常舒服。
screwdriver|n.|螺絲起子|You need a screwdriver to open the cover.|你需要一支螺絲起子才能打開蓋子。|He tightened the screw with a screwdriver.|他用螺絲起子把螺絲鎖緊。
wrench|n.|扳手|He used a wrench to tighten the bolt.|他用扳手把螺栓鎖緊。|The plumber took out a wrench from his toolbox.|水電工從工具箱裡拿出一支扳手。
pliers|n.|鉗子|Use pliers to pull out the nail.|用鉗子把釘子拔出來。|He cut the wire with a pair of pliers.|他用一把鉗子剪斷了電線。
bolt|n.|螺栓|One of the bolts on my bike is loose.|我腳踏車上有一根螺栓鬆了。|Tighten the nut onto the bolt.|把螺帽鎖到螺栓上。
rake|n.|耙子|He used a rake to gather the leaves.|他用耙子把落葉耙在一起。|The rake is in the garden shed.|耙子放在園藝工具間裡。
axe|n.|斧頭|He cut the firewood with an axe.|他用斧頭劈柴。|The axe is very sharp, so be careful.|這把斧頭非常鋒利，要小心。
toolbox|n.|工具箱|My dad keeps a hammer and nails in his toolbox.|我爸爸的工具箱裡放著榔頭和釘子。|Where is the toolbox?|工具箱在哪裡？
hose|n.|水管，軟管|He watered the garden with a hose.|他用水管幫花園澆水。|The hose is connected to the tap.|水管接在水龍頭上。
flashlight|n.|手電筒|Bring a flashlight in case the power goes out.|帶一支手電筒，以防停電。|He shone the flashlight into the dark cave.|他用手電筒照向黑暗的洞穴。
zoo|n.|動物園|We took the kids to the zoo on Sunday.|我們星期天帶孩子去動物園。|The zoo has two pandas.|這座動物園有兩隻貓熊。
church|n.|教堂|They got married in a small church.|他們在一間小教堂結婚。|The church bell rings every Sunday morning.|教堂的鐘每個星期天早上都會響。
temple|n.|廟，寺廟|Many people visit the temple during the New Year.|新年期間有很多人去廟裡參拜。|The old temple is on top of the mountain.|那座古老的寺廟位於山頂。
post-office|n.|郵局|I'm going to the post office to send a package.|我要去郵局寄包裹。|The post office closes at five.|郵局五點關門。
cafe|n.|咖啡廳|We met at a small cafe near the station.|我們在車站附近的一間小咖啡廳碰面。|She likes to read in a quiet cafe.|她喜歡在安靜的咖啡廳看書。
